9: ## User story
10: 
11: As a finance approver, I want Flyway physical persistence migrations for report runs, run artifacts, universal governance tickets, ticket comments, and ticket attachments with partial indexing on queued and running jobs, so that maker-checker workflows and runtime execution freeze checks operate with transactional integrity.

15: ### AC-1 — migrate report runs and run artifacts tables with constraints and foreign keys
16: Kind: happy
17: Given a PostgreSQL 15 database with `V1__baseline.sql`, `V2__iam_and_audit_schema.sql`, and `V3__configuration_and_seeded_definitions.sql` applied under `app/backend/src/main/resources/db/migration/`
18: When Flyway applies the `execution` and `governance` persistence migration (`V4__execution_and_governance_schema.sql`)
19: Then tables `report_runs` (`id`, `run_number`, `report_definition_id`, `recipe_version_id`, `triggered_by_user_id`, `trigger_type`, `report_period`, `status`, `idempotency_key`, `total_input_rows`, `valid_output_rows`, `exception_rows`, `error_code`, `error_detail`, `queued_at`, `started_at`, `completed_at`, `version`) and `run_artifacts` (`id`, `report_run_id`, `artifact_type`, `storage_bucket`, `storage_object_key`, `original_file_name`, `content_type`, `file_size_bytes`, `checksum_sha256`, `preview_rows_json`, `created_at`) are created with UUID primary keys, `UNIQUE` constraints on `report_runs.run_number`, `report_runs.idempotency_key`, and `run_artifacts(report_run_id, artifact_type)`, foreign keys `fk_runs_definition` (`report_definitions.id`), `fk_runs_recipe` (`recipe_versions.id`), `fk_runs_triggered_by` (`users.id`), and `fk_artifacts_run`

 `REJECTED`, `CANCELLED`), append-only auditability of `run_artifacts`, `ticket_comments`, and `ticket_attachments` (including SHA-256 `checksum_sha256` and storage metadata), transactional Runtime Execution Freeze verification (`ExecutionFreezePort.hasInFlightRuns` under `FOR UPDATE` row lock), and ArchUnit bounded-context isolation preventing direct cross-module repository/entity access (`security-baseline.mdc` §4, §5, §11; `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p1-contracts-and-data-models.md`).

83: ## Regulations
84:

## Context
